figure_caption: Fig. 7. The  $\mathrm{Al_2O_3}$  etch (nm/cycle) rate distribution across the wafer. The ordinate axis is the radius from the center of the wafer. The numbers around are the polar angle.
summary: a	The polar chart displays the relationship between the location on the wafer and etch rate of Al2O3.
q1: What is the highest observed difference in etch rate on the wafer?
a1: The largest difference in etch rate is 0.008 nm/cycle
q2: What can be a reason for non-uniformity in processing?
a2: An explanation for non-uniformity in ALE processes is the non-uniform distribution of reactants in the reactor.
q3: Which trend can be identified regarding the dependence of the etch rate on the position in the reactor?
a3: There seems to be solely a radial dependence. There is no uni-directional trend visible.
q4: Where has the etch process the highest performance (i.e. etch rate)?
a4: In the center of the reactor, in a circle with a radius of around 1 cm.
